headline: Q1 Internet of Things Earnings: Rockwell Automation (NYSE:ROK) Impresses
summary: The end of an earnings season can be a great time to discover new stocks and assess how companies are handling the current business environment. Let’s take a look at how Rockwell Automation (NYSE:ROK) and the rest of the internet of things stocks fared in Q1.
